mods.summary: Uses a local ElevenLabs Agents bridge for caller speech, microphone recognition and AI responses, with character-specific voices and language controls.

postInstall.description: Downloads the required Core, AI Backend and local ElevenLabs bridge, then opens setup. Requires Node.js 22.13+. If skipped, these dependencies and a running bridge must already be installed for the mod to work.

mods.summary: Remembers the price stated during a call. Successful credit-card scams add it to the original reward; gift-card scams pay that price after the correct fictional code is verified. In multiplayer, install on the host.

postInstall.description: Installs the required shared Core DLL from a pinned separate package and displays payout rules. If skipped, Core 1.0.4 or newer must already be installed in BepInEx/core for the mod to work.
